comparison.objective: Infer and tag a stuck valve on each pneumatic panel; candidate physically removes and contains HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual flow diagnosis and tag placement versus precise recessed-tool alignment, impact regulation, withdrawal, and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Correct red tags on the two stuck valves versus four valid fractures with all fragments recovered and no insert or shell damage. Tag-placement tolerances are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Diagnosis and labeling do not test controlled fracture or post-fracture recovery.
